design_inputs.name: Fn_DES
design_inputs.description: Design thrust target. Used by the balance component to solve for inlet mass flow.

design_inputs.name: T4_MAX
design_inputs.description: Combustor exit temperature (turbine inlet) target. Used by the balance component to solve for fuel-air ratio.

design_inputs.name: T4_TAKEOFF
design_inputs.description: Take-off rating: turbine inlet temperature at maximum power at and below 1,500 ft. Sets the engine's take-off thrust in the mission (engine deck); does not change the design point.

design_inputs.name: T4_CLIMB
design_inputs.description: Climb rating: turbine inlet temperature at maximum power from 2,000 ft up to the design altitude. Sets the engine's climb thrust in the mission (engine deck); does not change the design point. T4_MAX is the cruise rating at and above it.

design_inputs.name: splitter.BPR
design_inputs.description: Bypass ratio (bypass mass flow / core mass flow). Set on the splitter component — there is NO top-level 'BPR' input on this cycle.

design_inputs.name: hpc.PR
design_inputs.description: High-pressure compressor pressure ratio. Overall pressure ratio OPR ≈ fan.PR * lpc.PR * hpc.PR — set the three ratios individually, NOT a single 'OPR' input.

result.note: These are the canonical design-point inputs for this cycle. Pass any subset of these names verbatim to set_inputs — they are guaranteed to resolve. The full promoted-variable list from list_variables contains 900+ internal entries that are NOT safe to set directly.
